column4: ERR 0A000 {interval-opaque-value}: interval "1 mon" cannot be rendered as text: only a single-unit interval (YEAR, MONTH, WEEK, DAY, HOUR, MINUTE or SECOND) is supported

ERR 0A000 {timestamp-difference-to-number}: a timestamp difference (timestamp - timestamp) is an interval and cannot yet be used as the operand of a cast to text: compare the timestamps themselves instead, for example ts > TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '30 days' or a.ts …
ERR 42883: operator does not exist: timestamp without time zone - date

ERR 0A000 {bare-interval-result}: interval values cannot yet be used as a query result column: compare or apply an interval inline, cast it to text explicitly for display (CAST(... AS TEXT)), or use DURATION for a stored nanosecond duration
